# #410 — PROV-1: make python/ a uv workspace without regressing openbrain-memory

State: CLOSED

Part of #409.

Make `open-brain/python/` a uv workspace so a sibling package can exist beside `openbrain-memory`. Follows the `fleet-bus` pattern: root `pyproject.toml` with `[tool.uv.workspace] members = ["*"]`, members keep their own `pyproject.toml`.

`openbrain-memory` is standalone today (no workspace root, no shared lock). Adding the root moves its lockfile to the workspace, which touches an existing package's build - so this issue proves nothing regressed BEFORE any provider code is written.

## Scope
- Add `python/pyproject.toml` workspace root.
- `openbrain-memory/pyproject.toml` otherwise unchanged.
- Wire pre-push + CI to the same commands over the same paths.

## Acceptance
- `uv sync` resolves at the workspace root.
- `uv run mypy src/openbrain_memory`, `uv run ruff check src tests`, `uv run pytest -q` all pass for `openbrain-memory` - same results as before the change.
- `uv.lock` committed.
- CI green; pre-push runs the identical commands (a narrower local scope is a policy gap).

## Non-goals
No provider code. No changes to `openbrain-memory` source.
